evidence.staging: Independent explicitly synthetic success prerequisite, not natural play and not success of original seed-42 case. The selected deterministic seed and pure selection criterion are recorded. Serial ordinary services and conversations create general support through unchanged public writers and original seeded personalities. Five political responses are synthetic historical fixture actions through the real four-second adapter and core verifier, on declared fixture bodies/points; they are not production-scene geometry, navigation, meetings or visual evidence. Original IDs are retained, both guard ages remain null, and their context uses original-unaged-guard-duty. One planning case selects guard and abdication with five accepted policy decisions; no route preparation, resolution, investiture, office transfer, career, wages, clothes, rank, rooms, actor pose or production-scene state is installed. Fresh China startup must construct actual original bodies, then production main must perform and verify both six-second preparations, subsequent resolution, unique investiture and player imperial duties. Original usurpation-main-checkpoint.json is never read or written.
